notes.title: Major Update: Fight Ghosts with Your Camera!
notes.content: [p]This update introduces a brand new mechanic inspired by [i]Scare: Fatal Picture[/i].[/p][p align="start"]Use your drone’s camera to photograph and destroy the spirits haunting the abandoned school.[/p][p align="start"]What to expect:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920834/1d6546ecad1a69125bc90b08d20e489d463ed7a3.png"][/img][/p][p][b]- A new combat mechanic: fight ghosts with your camera[/b][/p][p align="start"][b]- New terrifying ghosts (yes, more than just the samurai!)[/b][/p][p align="start"][b]- A reimagined story with new notes to uncover[/b][/p][p align="start"][b]- An eerie new soundtrack[/b][/p][p align="start"][b]- Visual improvements and better graphics[/b][/p][p align="start"][b]- Full Controller Support[/b][/p]
